title: `--allow-inconclusive` never lowers a gate-refused relation the values read `violated`
note: The half `gate-refused-holds-at-values` could not test, because its relation is TRUE. `%` is outside the encodable fragment, so this engine reported the row `verification/unsupported-construct` — one of the two codes the flag lowers — and `--engine smt --allow-inconclusive` exited 0 over a requirement the tool's own numeric surface calls false, while `--engine literal --allow-inconclusive` exited 1 on the same file. `auto` resolves to `smt`, so that was the default invocation. §2: the flag never lowers a violation.
